findings_and_corrections: Independent HTTP probes caught missing no-store handling for 203/error/empty crawl responses, stale reuse after restrictive failed 304, duplicate Pragma loss and response-age reset during parsing. Fixed with permanent native/Python/HTTP regressions; original failing evidence remains.
Cache profile lookup can cross expiry. Recheck after RPC; keep parser/profile identity bound and refuse stale cache-only access.

First integrated CTest found a genuine 1-second durable-search compatibility regression. Original E2E stayed byte-identical; positive remaining time now uses a separate absolute steady-clock deadline.

First integrated CTest also exposed an old assertion expecting snippets from links_only fixture sources. The test now checks permission projection and has a separate explicitly permitted positive fixture, both including cache hits.
Generated executable mode repairs changed no binary bytes; pre-v2-file-modes.json records the single sanitizer revalidation executable repair.
limits: Component authors, independent reviewers and final integrator replays are distinguished; this is not complete independent product acceptance.
The old mode reviewer case remains as historical evidence and must not be treated as the corrected contract.
Real-source approval, human qrels, universal shared cancellation, independent revocation continuity, long-duration and complete Windows Worker packaging remain unaccepted.
Actual Windows/Linux remote CI is checked only after a real publication commit exists.
